annotations.title: Log a food from Enshape by reference

description: Creates one confirmed private diary entry from a ref returned by find_foods (verified menu item, reviewed restaurant meal or the user’s own food), get_nearby_meal_suggestions (combo) or get_usual_meals, get_meals and recent_foods (diary entry); own foods and diary entries need meals:read too. Enshape resolves and saves the per-serving nutrition, including micronutrients when known, and, when the grant includes meals:read, returns the saved values and totals to read back. Requires quantity, local date, meal slot and confirmed:true after the user confirms. Identical retries with the same requestId return the existing entry; a different request under it is rejected. Does not change the catalog.

confirmed.description: User explicitly confirmed this food, portion, meal slot and date.

date.description: User’s local calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

quantity.description: Servings of the referenced food (per-serving values are multiplied by it).

id.description: The id returned with that reference. Never a guessed or recalled id.

kind.description: verified: a restaurant menu item from find_foods; combo: a reviewed restaurant meal from find_foods or get_nearby_meal_suggestions; own: a food the user saved in Enshape; diary: a persisted diary entry from get_usual_meals, get_meals or recent_foods.

requestId.description: Idempotency key for one intended entry. A retry with the same reference, quantity, slot and date returns the original entry; anything else under this key is rejected.

name: log_food_reference

catalogUrl.description: Public Enshape page of the referenced menu item or meal.

logged.description: The saved values and totals to read back. Omitted unless the grant also includes meals:read.

openInEnshape.description: This date in the Enshape web diary (sign-in required).

id.description: The id returned with that reference. Never a guessed or recalled id.
